rationale: The agent processed returns for both orders (return_delivered_order_items called twice) but, per the escalation summary, not in the way the user requested (the user wanted each order refunded to the opposite order’s payment method). There is no visible confirmation from the user before performing these order-changing writes, which violates the policy requiring confirmation. Authentication is not clearly demonstrated beyond account/order lookups. The agent then transferred to a human after having already executed the returns, leaving the user dissatisfied. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy and fails the pass criteria.
